description: This file implements state management functions for the Slap Obj Wrapper Object, including setting object name, LPC party address, LPC party name, and resetting object state.

methods.name: SlapOwoSetObjName
methods.description: Sets the object name for the Slap Obj Wrapper Object.

methods.name: SlapOwoSetLpcPartyAddr
methods.description: Sets the LPC party address for the object, managing reference counts.

methods.name: SlapOwoSetLpcPartyName
methods.description: Sets the LPC party name for the object.

methods.name: SlapOwoReset
methods.description: Resets the object state, freeing memory and resetting references.
